ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Halder Venture Limited has approved the preferential allotment of 793,650 equity convertible warrants at Rs. 315 each to P.K. Bio Link Private Limited, a non-promoter entity, with 25% of the subscription amount already received. This capital-raising exercise is expected to infuse approximately Rs. 25 crore into the company upon full conversion, providing financial resources. However, it will lead to future equity dilution for existing shareholders and introduces a significant new non-promoter stakeholder, warranting consideration of its long-term impact on ownership structure.
